notes: comms.md is empty, so K7 has no opportunities. No head was ever powered, so K5 has none, and the Lampatronics 12V/boost-cable claim is unclear. Lampatronics' 'within an hour' assembly claim is counted under K1 (it matches the K1 example), not again under K4. In K2, stand asks count as 'fewer units' when a shop had 2-3 against Seb's stated need of about 20 (Thursday: explicit 20; Sunday: 'up to 20'). The Sunday Bab El Louk shop asked for exactly its 3 counts as false. Socket/testing requests are not items and are left out. In K2, Degla rubber bands were the worker's misreading of cable ties. In K6 the Sunday return rides are unclear: their arrivals were scheduled after the trial's last event. In K9, Seb's follow-ups on the round board, the stand heights and the unlit heads count as true; these calls are borderline.
